opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death, providing temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) until they can return home. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements, with fee waivers and additional funding allocated from Cara's own resources, plus help with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members.
